query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.
query_ground_truth.query: update Pipedrive deal participants and primary contacts
query_ground_truth.intent: Modify deal participants and primary contact associations for specific records.

requirement_groups.purpose: Update primary contacts on a deal

request.query: update Pipedrive deal participants and primary contacts

results.use_case: update Pipedrive deal participants and primary contacts
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if new contact ID unknown)]: Find the correct person record using PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS (match on stable attributes, not partial text).
[Optional (if you must confirm the exact person before writing)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the selected person using PIPEDRIVE_GET_PERSON (confirm it is the intended record).
[Optional (if you need to confirm current linkage before changing it)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch the deal using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL (note current linked person).
[Required] [Step]: Update the deal’s primary person link using PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL (set person_id to the selected person).
[Optional (if post-update verification is required)] [Next Step]: Re-fetch the deal using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL (confirm person linkage changed as intended).
[Fallback (if the update call fails or the endpoint is insufficient)] [Fallback]: Retry the same update using PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL_V2.
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL] Response payload can be very large with many custom-field keys; extract only fields needed to confirm person linkage.
[PIPEDRIVE_SEARCH_PERSONS] Searches may return multiple close matches; ensure you select the correct person_id before updating the deal.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL] Verification requires checking the deal’s linked person field, not unrelated deal metadata.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL.description: Tool to update an existing deal in Pipedrive. Use when you need to modify properties of a deal such as title, value, status, stage, or associated contacts/organizations.

id.description: The ID of the deal to update

value.description: The monetary value of the deal

org_id.description: The ID of the organization associated with the deal

status.description: The status of the deal. Must be one of: open, won, lost

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the deal value

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the deal

stage_id.description: The ID of the stage within the pipeline

won_time.description: Date and time when status changed to won

label_ids.description: Array of label IDs assigned to the deal

lost_time.description: Date and time when status changed to lost

person_id.description: The ID of the person/contact associated with the deal

close_time.description: Date and time of closing the deal (for won/lost status)

is_archived.description: Whether the deal is archived. Note: From July 15, 2025, archived deals cannot be edited except for this property.

lost_reason.description: Reason for losing the deal. Required when status is set to 'lost'

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline for the deal. When changed, stage_id auto-updates to first stage.

archive_time.description: Date and time of archiving in UTC in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format

expected_close_date.description: Expected closing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_DEAL_V2.description: Tool to update an existing deal using Pipedrive v2 API. Use when you need to modify deal properties including custom fields, archive status, or deletion status.

id.description: The ID of the deal to update

org_id.description: The ID of the organization linked to the deal

currency.description: The currency associated with the deal

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the deal

stage_id.description: The ID of the deal stage

won_time.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as won. Can only be set if deal status is won.

label_ids.description: The IDs of labels assigned to the deal

lost_time.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as lost. Can only be set if deal status is lost.

person_id.description: The ID of the person linked to the deal

close_time.description: The date and time of closing the deal. Can only be set if deal status is won or lost.

is_deleted.description: Whether the deal is deleted or not

is_archived.description: Whether the deal is archived or not

lost_reason.description: The reason for losing the deal. Can only be set if deal status is lost.

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline associated with the deal

probability.description: The success probability percentage of the deal (must be an integer)

archive_time.description: The optional date and time of archiving the deal in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. If omitted and is_archived is true, it will be set to the current date and time.

custom_fields.description: An object where each key represents a custom field. All custom fields are referenced as randomly generated 40-character hashes

expected_close_date.description: The expected close date of the deal in YYYY-MM-DD format

PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL.description: Tool to get details of a specific deal in Pipedrive. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a deal by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the deal to retrieve

custom_fields.description: Comma-separated list of custom field keys to include (maximum 15 keys). Use this parameter for faster results and smaller responses when only specific custom fields are needed.

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to include in the response. Acceptable values: next_activity_id, last_activity_id, first_won_time, products_count, files_count, notes_count, followers_count, email_messages_count, activities_count, done_activities_count, undone_activities_count, participants_count, last_incoming_mail_time, last_outgoing_mail_time, smart_bcc_email
